title: Aap kya jaane Fatema kya hai
body:
Aap kya jaane Fatema kya hai
Syeda, Tahira, Abida, Zahida, Taiyaba, Raziya, Marziya, Adila, Sajida Hura Batool e O Zara x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Surah e Qadr ka yeh nara hai
Ap kya janeey Fatima kya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis ko Mukhtar e amr kehthay hain
Jis ki ratoon ko qadr kehthay hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Subho ko jis ki Fajar kehthay hain
Shaam ko jis ki asr kehthay hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Har zamanay pay jis ka qabza hain
Ap kya janey Fatima kya hai x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Qadr jis ko sada qaza nay kaha
Syeda jis ko Murtaza nay kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Apni maa jis ko Mustafa nay kaha
Kanzay Maghfi jisay khuda nay kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis ki chokhat pay kaba jhukta hain
Ap kya janey Fatima kya hai x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis kay dar say ho hal ata ko ata
Inaman ki aman ka hai gosha
<<DIVIDER>>
Kul kafa jis ko khud gawaha bana
Fateha kar rahi hai jis ki sana
<<DIVIDER>>
Pura Quran hee qasida hai
Ap kya janey Fatima kya hai x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis ki chadar ko asmaan kahiye
Apnay bachon ka sahiban kahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Isko alhumd ka nishaan kahiye
Hushr kid hoop main amaan kahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Kulay imaan ka jo musala hai
Ap kya janey Fatima kya hai x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiska baba Rasool aashiq e rab
Jiskay baitay Hassan Hussain laqab
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh jahan main hain sab say acha nasab
Jiska shohar Ali ameer e arab
<<DIVIDER>>
Surah e noor jiska shajrah hai
Ap kya janey Fatima kya hai x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh gharaana sakhi mila humko
Isi ghar say Nabi mila humko
<<DIVIDER>>
Har wasi, har wali mila humko
Aik wali kya, Ali mila humko
<<DIVIDER>>
Isi ghar say khuda bhi paya hai
Ap kya janey Fatima kya hai x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiska aik baita hai Imam e Hassan
Aik baita Hussain Shah e Zaman
<<DIVIDER>>
Ai, Abbas mislay qila shikan
Jis nay seekha Ali say jang e ka fan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis ka dariya pay ab bhi qabza hai
Ap kya janey Fatima kya hai x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghazi bola mizaaj keher main hai
Mera hum pala koun sheher main hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyaas ka sud e baab neher main hai
Neher yeh Syeda ke neher main hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Meher yeh khud khuda nay rakha hai
Ap kya janey Fatima kya hai x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Dar pay jo sar jhuka nahi karta
Deen o Majid wo paa nahi sakta
<<DIVIDER>>
Har koyi dark o paa nahi sakta
Aira ghaira to aa nahi sakta
<<DIVIDER>>
Malakul mawt aa kay rukta hai
Ap kya janey Fatima kya hai x2
author: Shadman Raza
